info.title: Shalomut Map API (מפת שלומות)
info.description: Clean Data Layer & REST API for Shalomut Map — visualizing school staff wellbeing across 8 organic dimensions. Implements ADR-001 (Raw Data & Privacy Threshold Control).

post.summary: Request AI processing for a survey round
post.description: Forwards a round_closed event to AI_SERVICE_URL without a dynamic callback target. The AI service derives its callback URL from its trusted DATA_LAYER_CALLBACK_URL configuration and the round ID. The endpoint fails closed when the AI service is unavailable. A dispatch claim guarantees at most one concurrent run per round; a run requested while the previous claim is still held answers 409.

RoundAnalyticsResultV2.description: Immutable AI analytics input contract 2.0. Privacy-locked rounds return explicit empty dimensionScores and questionAggregates maps.

questionAggregates.description: Exactly 24 canonical aggregates when unlocked; empty when privacy locked.

RoundAnalyticsResultV3.description: Breaking dynamic-questionnaire input contract 3.0. Unlocked payloads contain exactly eight Core-owned dimension scores and every enabled persisted round question; locked payloads expose empty aggregate maps.

questionAggregates.description: One uniquely keyed aggregate for every enabled persisted question when unlocked; empty when privacy locked.

RoundAnalyticsResult.description: Consumer-first input compatibility union. Consumers accept immutable 2.0 and dynamic 3.0 during rollout.

StoneMapResultV2.description: Breaking semantic contract 2.0. Successful payloads contain exactly eight canonical stones; non-success payloads contain no detailed results.

StoneMapResultV3.description: Breaking dynamic-questionnaire output contract 3.0. Successful payloads contain exactly eight stones and variable question metrics grounded in the exact round snapshot.

StoneMapResult.description: Consumer-first compatibility union. Consumers accept immutable 1.0/2.0 and dynamic 3.0 before the Core producer switches to 3.0.
